metadata.question: Was there an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10,  2015?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about an algae bloom visible off the coast of Santa Monica on October 10, 2015. For algae bloom detection, I should use satellite imagery that can detect chlorophyll concentration or vegetation indices that can indicate algal presence. Best approach: 1. Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat imagery around October 10, 2015 2. Calculate NDVI or chlorophyll indices that can detect algae blooms 3. Focus on the coastal area near Santa Monica 4. Compare with normal conditions to detect anomalies I'll use: - Geometry: Polygon around Santa Monica Bay - Date range: ±5 days around Oct 10, 2015 to account for cloud cover - Collection: Landsat 8 (operational in 2015) or Sentinel-2 if available - Detection: Use NDVI or similar vegetation index, looking for unusually high values in water areas For algae detection in water, I can use: - NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) - algae will show positive values - FAH (Floating Algae Index) if available - Look for chlorophyll concentration bands Let me structure the code to: 1. Define Santa Monica coastal area 2. Get imagery for the target period 3. Calculate vegetation indices 4. Check if values indicate potential algae bloom 5. Handle missing data cases ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const santaMonicaCoast = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-118.55, 33.95], [-118.45, 33.95], [-118.45, 34.05], [-118.55, 34.05], [-118.55, 33.95] ]]); const targetDate = '2015-10-10'; const dateRange = ee.DateRange(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-5, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(5, 'day')); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Landsat 8 first (operational in 2015) let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(santaMonicaCoast) .filterDate(dateRange) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 Images in range: ${collectionSize}`); // If no Landsat images, try Sentinel-2 if (collectionSize === 0) { collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(santaMonicaCoast) .filterDate(dateRange) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 Images in range: ${collectionSize}`); } // Check for empty collection if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get best image (closest to target date, least clouds) const image = collection.sort('system:time_start', false).first(); const imageDate = ee.Date(image.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); console.log(`Using image from: ${imageDate}`); // 3. Processing - Calculate NDVI for algae detection let ndvi; if (image.get('SPACECRAFT_ID')) { // Landsat ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); } else { // Sentinel-2 ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } // Mask clouds and land (focus on water areas) let waterMask; if (image.get('SPACECRAFT_ID')) { // Landsat waterMask = image.select('SR_B3').gt(0); // Simple brightness threshold } else { // Sentinel-2 waterMask = image.select('B3').gt(0); } const maskedNDVI = ndvi.updateMask(waterMask); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats = maskedNDVI.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: santaMonicaCoast, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanNDVI = stats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean NDVI in coastal waters: ${meanNDVI ? meanNDVI.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (meanNDVI === null || meanNDVI === undefined || isNaN(meanNDVI)) { console.log("C3"); } else { // Algae blooms typically show positive NDVI values in water (unusual) // Threshold based on typical water NDVI (negative) vs algae (positive) const hasAlgaeBloom = meanNDVI > 0.1; // Conservative threshold console.log(`Algae detection threshold: ${meanNDVI > 0.1}`); console.log(hasAlgaeBloom ? "A" : "B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
